conceptual_change: Introduce a reversal-confluence filter by checking the distance from VWAP relative to the previous day's close for potential N-shape breakout candidates.
rationale: The strategy identifies stocks experiencing limit-up volatility. An N-shape pattern implies a retracement followed by a breakout. Using vwap_distance helps filter for mean-reversion pullbacks prior to the second leg of the breakout, ensuring the price is recovering toward the value area.
